prototype: Napoleonic Battle Sandbox, single-file HTML prototype (prototype/index.html). Dimensionless coefficients are ported unchanged; rates are rescaled from prototype time to real seconds (x7) and prototype pixels to metres (x1.4). See MODEL.md section 2.
assumption: Author's judgement. No source found; reasoning is in the parameter's note.
reglement-1791: Règlement concernant l'exercice et les manoeuvres de l'infanterie, 1 August 1791.
dundas-1792: David Dundas, Rules and Regulations for the Formations, Field-Exercise, and Movements of His Majesty's Forces, 1792.
scharnhorst-1813: Gerhard von Scharnhorst, Über die Wirkung des Feuergewehrs, Berlin 1813.
muller-1811: William Müller, The Elements of the Science of War, London 1811.
reisswitz-1824: Georg von Reisswitz, Anleitung zur Darstellung militairischer Manöver mit dem Apparat des Kriegs-Spieles, Berlin 1824.
du-picq: Charles Ardant du Picq, Études sur le combat, 1880.
hughes-firepower: B. P. Hughes, Firepower: Weapons Effectiveness on the Battlefield, 1630-1850, London 1974.
hughes-openfire: B. P. Hughes, Open Fire: Artillery Tactics from Marlborough to Wellington, Chichester 1983.
nafziger-bayonets: George Nafziger, Imperial Bayonets: Tactics of the Napoleonic Battery, Battalion and Brigade, London 1996.
muir-tactics: Rory Muir, Tactics and the Experience of Battle in the Age of Napoleon, New Haven 1998.
nosworthy-tactics: Brent Nosworthy, Battle Tactics of Napoleon and His Enemies, London 1995.
griffith-forward: Paddy Griffith, Forward into Battle, 2nd ed., Swindon 1990.
arnold-reappraisal: James R. Arnold, 'A Reappraisal of Column Versus Line in the Peninsular War', Journal of Military History 68 (2004).
kiley-artillery: Kevin Kiley, Artillery of the Napoleonic Wars, London 2004.
adkin-waterloo: Mark Adkin, The Waterloo Companion, London 2001.
barbero-battle: Alessandro Barbero, The Battle: A New History of Waterloo, 2005.
